newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Fong Hung in warrants placement.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong Hung in warrants placement.

text.p: Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said it would place 360 million warrants at HK$0.133 per warrant to institutional and private investors.

Each warrant entitles holders to the right to subscribe for new shares at an initial subscription price of HK$0.325 per share subject to adjustment. The warrants will expire on Feburary 28, 1998, the Chinese medicine retailer said.
Dealing in the warrants on the Hong Kong bourse is expected to begin on January 17, it said.
Tung Fong Hung shares edged up HK$0.01 to HK$0.425 in early Wednesday trading.
